_note: Offline advisory content. Stage timing is approximate and varies by variety and season. Scheme and insurance details must be verified against official sources before each season and before release.

stages.name: Nursery preparation
stages.general: Prepare a raised nursery bed. Soak seed for 24 hours and drain.
stages.organic: Use well-rotted compost or FYM in the nursery bed. Treat seed with Trichoderma.
stages.chemical: Treat seed with a recommended fungicide as per the label. Apply basal fertilizer as advised by your KVK.

stages.name: Transplanting
stages.general: Transplant 21 to 25 day old seedlings, 2 to 3 per hill. Keep 2 to 5 cm of standing water.
stages.organic: Apply compost or vermicompost in the main field before transplanting.
stages.chemical: Apply basal dose of DAP and potash as per soil test.

stages.name: Tillering
stages.general: Control weeds early. Check for stem borer and leaf folder. Keep water level low.
stages.organic: Apply neem cake as basal. Use Azolla and hand-weed. Spray 3% neem oil if pests appear.
stages.chemical: Top-dress urea in split doses. Use herbicide only as per label and timing.

stages.name: Panicle initiation
stages.general: Apply the second nitrogen dose. Keep field saturated. Scout for brown plant hopper.
stages.organic: Apply wood ash or potash-rich compost. Check for pests and remove affected plants.
stages.chemical: Apply remaining nitrogen and potash. Spray insecticide only if pest threshold is crossed.

stages.name: Flowering
stages.general: Avoid stress. Do not apply nitrogen now. Watch for blast and sheath blight.
stages.organic: Avoid extra nitrogen. Keep water in the field. Use neem-based sprays if needed.
stages.chemical: Apply fungicide only if disease is seen, and follow the label.

stages.name: Grain filling
stages.general: Keep the soil moist, but do not flood. Avoid spraying during rain or strong wind.
stages.organic: Keep field moist. Do not apply nitrogen.
stages.chemical: Avoid late spraying close to harvest. Follow the label's pre-harvest interval.

stages.name: Maturity and harvest
stages.general: Drain the field 7 to 10 days before harvest. Dry grain to about 14% moisture.
stages.organic: Harvest when most grains are golden. Dry on clean sheets, not directly on dirt.
stages.chemical: Respect the pre-harvest interval for any sprays used.

schemes.name: PM-KISAN
schemes.summary: Direct income support for eligible farmer families, paid in instalments to bank accounts.
schemes.verifyNote: Check current amount, eligibility and e-KYC status on the portal.

schemes.name: CM-KISAN (Odisha)
schemes.summary: State income support for farmers in Odisha, paid alongside PM-KISAN.
schemes.verifyNote: Ask the local Krushi Bhawan or agriculture office for current eligibility and instalments.

schemes.name: KALIA (Odisha)
schemes.summary: Odisha scheme for input support and livelihood assistance to small and marginal farmers.
schemes.verifyNote: Check current components and eligibility with the local agriculture office.

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
schemes.summary: Short-term credit for seed, fertilizer and other farm inputs through banks.
schemes.verifyNote: Apply through your bank or cooperative society.

insurance.premium: Farmer share for kharif food crops like paddy is a low fixed percentage of sum insured. The exact rate is set each season.
insurance.enrolment: Enrol before the seasonal cut-off through your bank, a Common Service Centre, or the PMFBY portal. Keep your land records and bank details ready.
insurance.claim: Report crop loss as early as possible. The scheme requires intimation within 72 hours of an event through the helpline, portal, app, or bank.
insurance.verifyNote: Check the current season's premium rate, cut-off date and helpline on the portal before advising a farmer.
